summary: Build practical workplace diversity skills using ISO 30415, inclusion diagnostics, and action planning. Explore the course and see what you will produce.
lede: Workplace diversity training helps HR professionals and people managers assess inclusion across recruitment, employee experience, and development. Through practical exercises, they interpret workforce data, review accessibility and AI-assisted hiring risks, and build a focused action plan with progress measures, using the Global Diversity, Equity & Inclusion Benchmarks as a reference.
audienceIntro: This intermediate workplace diversity course is for professionals responsible for fair, accessible, and inclusive people practices across recruitment, employee experience, and development.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with workplace policies, recruitment, employee development, or team supervision is recommended. No coding is required. Bring a general understanding of your organization’s people processes; the course uses scenario-based examples rather than requiring confidential workforce data.
